crossRefs.note: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
Have we no right to eat and to drink?
But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

translations.web: not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.
translations.bsb: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
translations.kjv: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
